# Combined v0.22 integration: held candidate

## Completed

Integrated the independently reviewed online-race car-contact patch into a fresh copy of combined-v021-integration. The full tuner and opted-in online corner/braking parity remain intact. No released/frozen archive was overwritten. No live user game, installation or network session was touched.

The new exact93af6ccb capability extends the independent Online player / race no-clip switch with mode4. Race mode requires explicit network permission, active Online/LAN race, one local player, matching current car/race/body/contact identity, bounded2–6 inline racer records, reciprocal record binding, fresh heartbeat and unchanged sequences. Both contacted cars must occur exactly once. Unrelated roster entries are range/alignment checked, but the code does not claim universal integrity of unrelated records.

Only local native contact resolution is skipped. This does not change packets, server/peer state, Ghost settings, map geometry or remote simulation, and it does not guarantee another player sees no collision. Wall and NPC-traffic filtering remain separately scoped; older game profiles retain their previous behavior. Solo/Street X driving and handling formulas remain unchanged.

## Integration safeguard

The original contact candidate's builder reconstructed a64-local next profile and would have removed the full tuner. The adapted builder now validates that its rebuilt base bridge equals the existing reviewed fullTuner.baseBridge, recomposes the170-local tuner prefix, preserves metadata/capability, and checks all unrelated profile properties. An unexpected base change fails before replacing the profile. Two isolated rebuild tests certify idempotence and mismatch refusal.

The only manual patch conflict was session-help wording, merged to retain both online corner/braking and local race-contact descriptions. Native grip/downforce remains disabled. No Lap Knockout or new Drag changes are included.

## Verification

- Final complete serialized suite: **1,619 passed,0 failed/skipped/cancelled** (`all-tests-final.txt`).
- Independent candidate scope:155 focused tests plus5 extra native groups.
- Independent integrated scope:223 focused tests plus5 extra native groups, including builder protection, real native collision wrapper, tuner, online corners and braking.
- Relative to v0.21, only native function22508 differs. All other function bodies and non-code sections are unchanged. Full tuner bridge/metadata/locals170, previous capabilities and online corner/braking implementation are preserved.
- Accepted native write footprint is limited to existing ghost pair-pass bookkeeping, return CPU state and dedicated counters/status. No peer/network or roster writes.
- Fresh-copy reproduction: apply integrated-v022.patch to frozen v0.21, run guarded next-profile builder, compare all21 changed files including regenerated cars-next.wasm, then build a byte-identical archive. See REPRODUCE.md and reproduction-results.json.
- Independent review: `nfsu2-extension/research/online-race-collision-v018/INDEPENDENT-MERGE-REVIEW.md`.

# v0.32 race-only AI and optional adaptive road pace

## Delivered scope

Fresh integration from frozen v0.31. New features are current-page, default-off choices. Existing named-profile storage, native AI policy, exact-build/ownership gates and online permission rules are preserved. This release does not find, join, start, replay or vote for races.

Race-only automatic driver waits for a supported active ordinary race (HUD 1, native type 1, phase 4), including Street X, Drag and Drift. It releases in free roam, Outrun, results or unsafe contexts. Selecting it disables all-modes AI; selecting all-modes AI disables race-only arming. It stays armed between races on the current page but resets on reload, profile Load, F7/F9/Stop or race driving-key takeover. Manual free-roam steering preserves arming; physically held driving keys at race entry delay acquisition until released. Existing native manual requests, end/totaled states, failure latch, OFF acknowledgement and watchdog are not bypassed.

Optional Adaptive road-race speed uses the existing native pace, route-corner and braking controls at a constant selected ceiling (default 1.30, range 1.00–2.00). The native route planner varies target speed by distance. It does not implement JavaScript per-corner control or a new steering/braking/NOS algorithm. Street X actual, forced and known online modes preserve exact old effective controls; Drag, Drift, Outrun and free roam are excluded. The selector uses the effective race-only/all-modes AI request, never enables either mode or network permission itself. F7 leaves adaptive selected but dormant; F9/profile Load/reload clear it.

Both new choices deliberately stay outside saved-profile schema and legacy session storage. Existing saved profiles can still restore their own all-modes AI choice; these new session switches are not saved by Save/Update.

## Implementation and merge

Standalone race-only work is frozen at `race-only-ai-v032-candidate`, with `integration/race-only-ai/source-only.patch` and provenance. It changes page scheduling, bounded diagnostic booleans and tests only. The standalone suite passes 1,890 tests; independent review passes 24 new matrices and 113 retained regressions.

Adaptive source patch: `adaptive-pace-v032-candidate/integration/adaptive-pace/adaptive-pace.patch`, SHA-256 `6ec580e2162cad0b67ca5bf368e542668dc3d24ce1900d73e0cf93b4a2a0e28a`. The combined merge explicitly reconciles the shared UI/telemetry/stop/profile paths. Race-only eligibility is computed before adaptive selection, which receives effective `aiRequested`. Both choices clear their current status evidence on suspension and replacement boot. No stale active row survives engine exit or tuner activity.

Independent review found and verified a stale race-only status row during early-return paths; it was fixed before final packaging. The row now clears to armed/waiting without discarding the user choice. Tooltip text exposes long status explanations.

## Verification

- Final combined aggregate: **1,907 passed**, zero failures/skips/cancellations (`all-tests-final.txt`).
- 34 focused race-only/adaptive/joint groups pass, including 100 type/HUD/phase combinations, all network signals, ownership handback, current keys, profile/reload behavior and exact Street X command equality. New memory equality tests use actual copied bytes, not shared views.
- Independent combined matrix: 31 checks passed, including production Controller/native bridge lifecycle and five cached-route transitions with 100 stable ticks without repeated reconstruction. Exact-native fixtures are bounded by existing controlled low-level leaves; they are not gameplay simulations.
- Every supported patched module (legacy/current/latest/next) compiles and is byte-identical to v0.31. Every function and non-code section is unchanged. Evidence: `research/race-only-ai-v032/module-preservation-all-four.json`.
- AI Controller, native profiles/builders, tuner/private evaluator, NOS clock logic, tool-profile schema and existing Engine/StableGate implementations are unchanged. `core.js` only adds the reviewed pure adaptive selector.
- Complete source change plus five builders reproduces the internal 24-file versioned release ZIP byte-for-byte. The user-facing same-folder package uses the existing reviewed flat builder; runtime bytes and permissions are unchanged by packaging.

Final tests and reproduction files are in this directory. Independent review evidence is under `research/race-only-ai-v032`; adaptive native evidence is under `research/dynamic-pace-v031-native`.

## Update and limits

Deliver only `NFSU2-Driving-Tools-v0.32-Same-Folder-Update.zip`. Copy its files into the existing loaded extension folder, replace matching files, click Reload on the same browser extension card, then refresh the game and verify 0.32.0. Do not remove/re-add or create another version folder. The internal versioned archive exists only for source/package reproducibility checks.

No live game, browser installation, account or save was changed. Live race efficacy, lap times, wins, corner safety, native scheduling and browser appearance remain unverified. Hook counters and selected ceilings do not prove actual speed/braking performance. No unsupported grip/downforce, unrelated Drag lane, hosted-lobby automation or game-save action is included.

## Final artifact approval

The user-facing flat package is 235,207 bytes, SHA-256 `40bf3c98d6083d34e8ad99afbb6b95479898707f6b3dac5329eb9b863d6a3651`. Independent review passes all 26 flat safe names, all 23 unchanged source runtime/changelog payloads, README-only installation/rollback transformation, guide and 25 payload checksums, CRCs, canonical metadata, source immutability and byte-identical rebuilding. Internal 24-file package also passes. Packaging builder regression: 26/26. No open blockers.

+

+- Preserves online opt-in, native manual requests, OFF acknowledgement, finished/totaled states, failed-control latch and watchdog. F7/F9/Stop and race driving-key takeover disarm it; held controls delay acquisition. Free-roam steering leaves it armed. +- Adds default-off adaptive road-race speed using existing native route/corner/braking controls and a separate 1.00–2.00× target ceiling, default 1.30×. Street X retains exact prior effective controls; Drag, Drift, Outrun and free roam are excluded. No per-corner JavaScript control or new native hook.

+## Optional adaptive road-race speed
+
+A new **default-off, session-only** option coordinates the existing native route planner. Its separate straight-target ceiling defaults to **1.30×** and ranges from 1.00× to 2.00×. The native route uses distance to known corners to lower its target in advance while retaining a higher target on sufficiently long straights. This is a planned target factor, not a physical speed cap or a measured speed increase.
+
+Enable either **Race-only automatic driver** or **Automatic driver**, then **Adaptive road-race speed** in AI driver → Road-race settings. Online use also requires **Allow network tools**. Adaptive mode uses the existing Race corner speed, Race sharp-turn margin and Race braking factor values, even when the separate Road-race hairpin assist switch is off. Lower braking factor requests earlier braking. It overrides the effective custom race pace only in eligible ordinary road races, without changing any saved switch or slider.
+
+**Street X keeps the exact existing pace, corner and braking selections.** Adaptive mode is dormant in actual/forced Street X and the known online Street X mode. Drag, Drift/forced variants, Outrun and free roam are also excluded. Selecting adaptive mode does not turn on Automatic driver or network permission.
+
+The optional ceiling stays constant while driving. The existing native route envelope varies by distance; JavaScript does not switch pace or reconstruct the driver at every corner. A deliberate setting or race-mode change may still require the existing OFF/acknowledgement/ON route reconstruction. Manual takeover, race end, permission withdrawal and the existing watchdog remain in force.
+
+F7/manual driving keys stop AI and leave the optional selection dormant. F9/Stop, profile Load and page reload turn adaptive mode off. It is not added to saved tool profiles or legacy session preferences. Blur, hidden page and menus pause it normally. Turn it off to return to the prior controls after native handoff.
+
+The HUD and local log distinguish a request, matching native pace acknowledgement, and observed corner/braking hook evidence. These counters do not measure braking success, safe corner entry or a clean lap. There is no new steering, obstacle avoidance, NOS control, added route horizon, opponent manipulation or collision protection. Higher targets can still cause crashes. Start at 1.30× and assess one change at a time.
+
+Only page orchestration, a pure selector and bounded diagnostics change. # v0.25 combined saved settings profiles

Outcome: implemented, fully regression-tested and independently reviewed as a local candidate. No live user game was modified.

## Deliverable

`NFSU2-Driving-Tools-v0.25-Combined-Saved-Profiles.zip`, 214,596 bytes.

SHA-256: `8166d0332eadcd7abe2b4fc9ecfc0fa5e17c76548c286e940deb4e6c0b617cc6`.

Library ID: `libfile_fde3_f-aef17fee22fc8191bc4594c7fd9ea0d4_8b516292de4881919d77c9d94b12acf3`.

## User workflow

Disable older Driving Tools extension copies, load this extracted extension folder, reload the game and verify the panel says 0.25.0. Choose the desired tools, open Saved tool profiles, enter a name, optionally check Restore network settings, then Save as new. Enable Load on startup for the selected saved profile if automatic restoration is wanted. Otherwise Load selected restores it on demand. Update selected replaces its stored choices; updating a startup profile disables that startup choice until explicitly enabled again.

F9 clears active driving/network tools and persistently pauses startup loading while preserving saved profiles. Manual Load resumes current selections; explicitly enabling Load on startup resumes future automatic restoration. Network restoration requires the saved per-profile consent. Existing module, identity and context restrictions still apply. The Drag heat toggle still only protects a current eligible unblown local engine; no repeated-NOS or race-win claim.

## Storage and safety

Strict bounded schema: 16 named profiles, 48-character names, 32 KiB encoded storage cap. Values are allowlisted and typed/range checked; unknown, hostile, malformed or unsupported records do not load. DOM names use text, not HTML. Profiles hold extension toggles/numbers and tuner enable/search preference, not game setups, drafts, car data or logs. No automatic search, Stage, Restore or game save.

Browser Web Locks serialize production profile mutations. Queued actions capture click intent and revision and are invalidated by Stop, restored-page lifecycle and remote Stop changes; queued startup authorization also checks the durable Stop token. Missing/denied locking disables edits, not manual Load. Storage events refresh lists without activating profiles. Delayed mount revalidates startup choices and permissions. Unreadable storage suppresses stale legacy driving restores. If Stop cannot persist, UI warns to restore storage and press F9/Stop again before reload. Separate drift/tester semantics remain; no new native drift operation is issued on Stop.

## Verification

- Aggregate: **1,688 passed, zero failures/skips/cancellations**, `all-tests-final.txt`.
- Final packaging tests: 3 passed after documentation updates, `package-tests-final.txt`.
- Independent storage + VM/DOM review: **44 passed**, including two-tab writes, queued targets, lost-update prevention, interrupted startup, consent, F9, storage recovery, pending dyno/drift and unchanged staged drafts. See `research/settings-profiles-v025/`.
- All 17 protected native/runtime scripts and native builders/WASM byte-identical to v0.24. No Street X, heat, NOS, steering, tuner stage/restore, corner/braking or collision payload changed. Native grip/downforce remains unverified and disabled. No Lap Knockout experiment.
- `integrated-v025.patch` applies to frozen `combined-v024-integration` without conflicts. Three builders reproduce all 12 changed files and the byte-identical final ZIP. See `reproduce.py` and `reproduction-results.json`.

A local Chromium fixture launch was blocked by denied Unix socket creation, including its reviewed retry. No alternate route around the restriction was attempted. Browser appearance, actual extension installation, live game reload/automatic restoration, race outcomes and game-save persistence remain unverified. VM/DOM tests are not browser/live-game tests. No live actions or user data transmission occurred beyond uploading the requested release artifact.

+

+- Optional automatic loading is off by default and requires an explicit choice. Network restoration has separate per-profile consent. Existing native capability, ownership and game-context guards remain unchanged.

+## v0.25.0: Saved extension settings profiles
+
+**Saved tool profiles** saves named groups of extension settings in this browser for this game site. Save your current choices, then load them together instead of enabling each tool separately. Update replaces the selected saved configuration; Delete removes it. These profiles are separate from the game's race tuning presets and **Save Profile**. They contain no car setup, game save, dyno draft or diagnostic log.
+
+Automatic loading after reload is **optional and off by default**. Select it explicitly for a saved configuration if you want that configuration to return next time. Network permission has a separate saved-profile opt-in: saved choices do not silently grant Online/LAN access. Read the network warning before permitting automatic network-enabled behavior. Each tool still requires the supported build, valid current car and its normal game-mode checks.
+
+**F9 / Stop keeps saved profiles but pauses automatic loading persistently**, as well as clearing current driving/network choices. A later reload cannot silently undo Stop. Resume deliberately from the profile controls. Saving a profile does not itself enable its settings. Changes from another tab do not automatically activate a configuration in an already-open tab.
+
+Profile loading stops the old controllers and releases synthetic input before changing selections. It does not roll back a staged game tune or save the game. If storage is unavailable or full, the UI reports that the profile was not saved. Profiles stay in this browser; clearing this site's storage removes them, and site scripts can access this storage. Up to 16 profiles and 48 characters per name are supported. Browser-managed locking prevents concurrent tabs from overwriting each other's saves; if locking is unavailable, profile editing is disabled while manual loading remains available.
+
+Saved Drag blowout protection retains its narrow meaning: only the current eligible local engine is protected before it blows; online use also needs network permission. It does not revive an already-blown engine, alter NOS/shifting, or promise a race win. Existing controls keep their normal fresh-page defaults unless you explicitly enable a saved startup profile. Descriptions below that say a control starts off refer to those defaults.
+
+No native AI, Street X, tuning, heat, corner/braking or collision payload was changed for settings profiles. The final suite passes 1,688 tests, with another 44 independent profile checks. A local Chromium fixture could not launch because this environment denied socket creation, so browser appearance and automatic loading in the user's game remain unverified.
+
+## Retained v0.24.0: Opted-in online Drag engine blowout protection
 
 For **online or LAN Drag**, enable both **Drag racing → Disable Drag engine blowouts** and **Online / LAN opt-in → Allow network tools** before the engine blows. Solo Drag needs only the blowout toggle. Exact **93af6ccb** and **78e2bb69** builds are supported. The heat toggle works independently of Automatic driver and Manual drag assist. It starts off for a fresh tab, remembers your choice in the same tab, and F9 clears it. Network permission starts off after reload and F9.

+/* Named extension choices only. Never stores game setups, car data or diagnostics.
+ * Synchronous storage core: page.js serializes save/remove/setAuto with Web Locks.
+ * Stop uses an independent marker and never waits for the profile-write lock. */
+(function(root) {
+  'use strict';
+  const KEY='nfsu2-driving-tools-profiles-v1', STOP_KEY=KEY+'-stop';
+  const MAX_PROFILES=16, MAX_NAME=48, MAX_BYTES=32768;
+  const FLAGS=['raceCornerAssist','cornerAssist','racePace','walls','cars','traffic','players','online','ai','aiPace','nos','dragNoBlowout','drag','tester','boost','unlimit','grip','dynoEnabled'];
+  const NUMBERS={raceCornerFactor:[0.6,0.95],raceCornerMargin:[0,25],raceBraking:[0.5,1],racePaceFactor:[0.75,3],cornerFactor:[0.6,0.95],cornerMargin:[0,25],paceFactor:[0.75,3],rpm:[3000,10000],power:[1,3],gripFactor:[1,2]};
+  const GOALS=['peakPower','peakTorque','acceleration60','acceleration100','topSpeed'];
+  const forbidden=new Set(['__proto__','constructor','prototype']);
+  const token=()=>Date.now().toString(36)+'-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,14);
+  const validToken=value=>typeof value==='string'&&/^[a-z0-9-]{1,64}$/.test(value);
+  function fail(text){throw Error(text);}
+  function exact(value,keys){
+    if(!value||typeof value!=='object'||Array.isArray(value))fail('Invalid profile storage.');
+    const proto=Object.getPrototypeOf(value);
+    if(proto!==null&&Object.getPrototypeOf(proto)!==null)fail('Invalid profile object.');
+    const own=Object.keys(value);
+    if(own.length!==keys.length||own.some(k=>forbidden.has(k)||!keys.includes(k)||!Object.hasOwn(Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(value,k),'value')))fail('Invalid profile fields.');
+  }
+  function settings(value){
+    exact(value,[...FLAGS,...Object.keys(NUMBERS),'drift','dynoGoal']);
+    const out={};
+    for(const k of FLAGS){if(typeof value[k]!=='boolean')fail('Invalid profile switch.');out[k]=value[k];}
+    for(const [k,[min,max]] of Object.entries(NUMBERS)){const n=value[k];if(!Number.isFinite(n)||n<min||n>max)fail('Invalid profile number.');out[k]=n;}
+    if(value.drift!==null&&typeof value.drift!=='boolean')fail('Invalid drift choice.');
+    if(!GOALS.includes(value.dynoGoal))fail('Invalid tuner preference.');
+    out.drift=value.drift;out.dynoGoal=value.dynoGoal;return out;
+  }
+  function name(value){
+    if(typeof value!=='string'||!value.trim()||value.length>MAX_NAME||/[\u0000-\u001f\u007f-\u009f]/.test(value)||forbidden.has(value.trim().toLowerCase()))fail('Use a profile name of 1–48 characters without control characters.');
+    return value.trim();
+  }
+  const empty=()=>({schema:1,profiles:[],auto:null});
+  function decode(raw){
+    if(raw===null)return empty();
+    if(typeof raw!=='string'||raw.length*2>MAX_BYTES)fail('Profile storage is too large. Nothing was loaded.');
+    let value;
+    try{value=JSON.parse(raw,(key,v)=>{if(forbidden.has(key))fail('Invalid profile key.');return v;});}catch{fail('Profile storage is damaged. Nothing was loaded or overwritten.');}
+    exact(value,['schema','profiles','auto']);
+    if(value.schema!==1||!Array.isArray(value.profiles)||value.profiles.length>MAX_PROFILES)fail('Unsupported or invalid profile storage.');
+    const ids=new Set(),names=new Set();
+    for(const p of value.profiles){
+      exact(p,['id','name','settings','networkConsent','revision']);
+      if(!validToken(p.id)||!validToken(p.revision)||typeof p.networkConsent!=='boolean')fail('Invalid saved profile.');
+      if(name(p.name)!==p.name||ids.has(p.id)||names.has(p.name.toLowerCase()))fail('Invalid or duplicate saved profile.');
+      ids.add(p.id);names.add(p.name.toLowerCase());p.settings=settings(p.settings);
+    }
+    if(value.auto!==null){exact(value.auto,['id','stopToken']);if(!ids.has(value.auto.id)||!validToken(value.auto.stopToken))fail('Invalid automatic profile choice.');}
+    return value;
+  }
+  function create(storage){
+    let current=empty(),lastRaw=null,stopToken='initial',error='',available=false;
+    function refresh(){
+      try{
+        if(!storage)fail('Local storage is unavailable. Profiles cannot be saved or automatically loaded.');
+        const raw=storage.getItem(KEY),stopped=storage.getItem(STOP_KEY);
+        if(stopped!==null&&!validToken(stopped))fail('Invalid profile Stop marker. Automatic loading is blocked.');
+        const next=decode(raw);
+        // Autoload also requires functioning writes, so read-only/blocked storage fails closed.
+        const probe=KEY+'-probe',value=token();storage.setItem(probe,value);
+        if(storage.getItem(probe)!==value)fail('Local storage could not be verified.');
+        storage.removeItem(probe);
+        if(storage.getItem(KEY)!==raw||storage.getItem(STOP_KEY)!==stopped)fail('Profiles changed while reading storage. Select the profile again.');

+      return {durable,error};
+    }
+    refresh();return {refresh,snapshot,save,load,remove,setAuto,startup,pause};
